The '''Xyquine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xyquine II]].
